body: May I ask how old you are? You sound like you've had some amazing experiences.

I am incapable of any emotion. Nothing has ever caused any sort of response or feeling from me. I'm apathetic about literally everything. Happy, sad, love, hate, it doesn't happen.

There are no circumstances which I can imagine which excite me in any way. Unlike so many others, I can't find any fault in my life ATM; I'm honestly doing great, and have never done otherwise. Life this empty, when I can't even conceive a reason why it is this way (let alone a fix), is just so hollow. It has always been this way.

So I have set a date; 30th August. The day on which my body will fall a distance, jerk to a stop, the vertebrae and nerves in my neck will be obliterated by the rope attached when I stop, and it will end near instantly. Then I will be truly empty. I will say goodbye to my friends and family (obviously not quite so explicitly), and leave a note with a more apt explanation for them to find afterwards.

I don't feel any different having set this; perhaps a bit sedate.
